units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 50:21">Targ. Gen. L, 21</cite> <cite ref="N00503"><he>נָחַם</he></cite> ed. Berl. (v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 18).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 61:2">Targ. Is. LXI, 2</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 2:11">Targ. Job II, 11</cite> <he>לנַחֲמוּתֵיה</he> to comfort him.—Part. <cite ref="M01760"><he>מְנַחֵם</he></cite>, pl. <he>מְנַחֲמִין</he>, v. <cite ref="N00503">preced.</cite>
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 10:3">Targ. II Sam. X, 3</cite>.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 8b:6">Keth. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>אתא לנַחוּמֵי צעורי וכ׳</he> he came to console, and he grieved him? Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ bot., a. e. <he>בעי מְנַחַמְתֵּיה</he> desired to comfort him.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 19a:14">Snh. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מְנַחֲמֵי אחריני וכ׳</he> when others comfort him; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 42:6">Targ. Job XLII, 6</cite>; a. fr.—Y. l. c. <he>ולא קביל עלוי מִתְנַחֲמָה</he> and would not allow himself to be comforted; a. e.
